verdicts.reading: Closed-loop systems that read brain signals and feed back stimulation to drive a chosen brain function are generally available around 2022. The poster's first sentence is a general definition; the second names the mechanism, so one reading. Test (D37 Horizons): buyable by ordinary customers outside pilots by 2024.
verdicts.reason: A's reading (a), generic intelligence-amplifying software, was available long before 2014 and would make the 2022 placement empty; it is not equally faithful, so unfalsifiable does not apply. B's miss overlooks consumer closed-loop neurostimulation: Dreem (2017, $499) read EEG and played phase-timed sound to deepen slow-wave sleep, and Elemind (June 2024 launch, $349, shipping Sept 2024) reads EEG and applies phase-locked acoustic stimulation for sleep onset. Both read the brain and stimulate it to accomplish a brain function, buyable by consumers within Y+2. But they target sleep, not cognition proper, and are single niche products; no cognition-augmenting closed-loop product is sold. Real but limited = partial. A strict 'cognition only' reading gives provisional miss, so this call is less certain.

evidence.title: Elemind Launches First of its Kind Sleep On Demand Headband
evidence.shows: Consumer EEG headband with closed-loop, phase-locked acoustic stimulation launched commercially; $349 pre-order, shipping late Sept 2024.

evidence.title: Neurotech Company Rythm Launches Dreem
evidence.shows: Dreem headband sold to consumers ($499): real-time EEG closed-loop analysis with auditory stimulation to enhance deep sleep; later withdrawn from consumer sale.

evidence.title: Medtronic earns U.S. FDA approval for the world's first Adaptive deep brain stimulation system
evidence.shows: Implanted closed-loop stimulation exists only as therapy (Parkinson's motor symptoms), not cognitive augmentation.

verdicts.reading: Second-generation biofuels (named examples: cellulosic ethanol, microalgae biodiesel) are generally available around 2021. Test (D37 Horizons): fuel buyers outside pilots could purchase 2G biofuel by 2023; earlier counts.
verdicts.reason: D37 tests availability, not market share. Raizen's Costa Pinto plant (built 2014, ~40 million L/yr) sold cellulosic E2G commercially, including export cargoes to the EU; in Nov 2022 Raizen signed a 3.3 billion litre E2G offtake with Shell to 2037, and Bonfim started in 2023. Business buyers could buy 2G ethanol outside pilots by 2023. A graded volume and refinery closures (a share test) rather than availability. Algal biodiesel was abandoned, but the label is the category and one named pathway is commercially sold.
